name: What role does pricing play in starting a bidding war?

mainEntity.name: What role does pricing play in starting a bidding war?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strategic pricing is fundamental to initiating a bidding war. Often, listing a property slightly below its market value can generate significant interest, leading to multiple offers that drive the price up. Conversely, overpricing can deter buyers, reducing interest and the likelihood of competitive bids. A nuanced understanding of the local market, including recent comparable sales in areas like Palm Beach and Collier County, helps determine the optimal listing price to attract aggressive offers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pricing a home strategically, often slightly below market value, can attract more buyers and encourage a bidding war by generating high interest.
